title: Playable model narrative
summary: Advance an explanation by making the user repeatedly act inside the model, then use the outcomes to introduce the next rule, strategy, or argument.

title: Editable model sandbox
summary: Expose meaningful model parameters or rules for direct manipulation while keeping simulation, derived values, and explanatory views synchronized to the same state.

title: Linked computation inspection
summary: Reveal a hidden local computation by linking source values, the operation applied to them, and the resulting output under one hover, cursor, or selected location.

title: World as interface
summary: Let navigation and selection happen through movement inside a persistent spatial world rather than through separate page or menu transitions, while retaining recovery and alternate access paths.

title: Cross-modal input mapping
summary: Map one immediate user gesture or discrete input to coordinated outputs in multiple sensory channels so visual form and sound feel like one instrument rather than separate feedback systems.

title: Sensor-mediated environment
summary: Use sensed body, biometric, or presence data to alter the surrounding spatial field directly, making the participant part of the environment's state rather than a controller of a detached interface.

title: Boundaryless spatial content
summary: Allow content to migrate across spatial containers so context is determined by the viewer's location and neighboring works rather than by one fixed screen, room, or card.

title: Path-paced spatial choreography
summary: Compose one evolving light, sound, or kinetic system across a path so each visitor samples its temporal sequence through their own movement and pace.

title: Data as environment
summary: Scale dense scientific or computational data into an audiovisual field that surrounds attention and uses rhythm, precision, layering, and spatial extent as part of the representation.
